Subject: Renewal kickoff: Acme Health — timeline, QBR, capacity

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As we discussed, I wanted to kick off formal renewal planning so we can lock in a smooth transition for the July–September term and review capacity and potential uplift ahead of your QBR. High level asks below — I pulled a first draft SOW and a quick capacity snapshot for your review (attached).

Quick agenda / asks for this thread:
- Confirm decision-makers and procurement contact we should include (we already have Tom + Elena).
- Proposed renewal window: sign by 2026-07-20 to avoid pricing step and guarantee burst capacity in August.
- QBR timing: propose week of 2026-06-30; please confirm 30 Jun or 1 Jul availability.
- Capacity ask: current committed GPU hours vs projected peak — can you share peak-hour TPS and approximate daily token volume?

Attachments: Acme_SOW_v1.3.pdf (draft term changes + uplift options), capacity_snapshot.xlsx (current usage + small-step upsell scenarios).

Next steps I suggest: Elena/Tom confirm QBR slot and procurement contact; Jordan + Naomi will prepare recommended uplift tiers and a short cost/latency tradeoff summary for the meeting.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m sync if helpful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Acme Health — timeline, QBR, capacity

Hi Mateo —

Appreciate the draft and the clear asks. Quick responses:
- Procurement point: procurement@acmehealth.com (cc'ed).
- Decision-makers: Caroline Lim (VP Product), myself — Caroline will join the QBR if available.
- QBR: 2026-06-30 at 10:30 PT works for us; if you prefer 1 Jul we can also do 1 Jul 09:00.
- Peak numbers: we typically see peak TPS around 1.2k requests/min between 14:00–16:00 ET; daily tokens average ~220M with spikes up to ~380M on campaign days. We'll attach a short export after this email.

Two small asks on the SOW: can you add a clause for data residency (EU patients) for any logs used in debugging, and include the 99.5% latency SLO language we discussed?

Thanks — will follow up with Caroline and Procurement for formal availability.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of AI Integrations, Acme Health
elena.park@acmehealth.com

Elena — thanks for the numbers, that's helpful. A couple things our ops team will coordinate on before the QBR: 

- Quick pre-read I'll prepare for the QBR (one pager): current SLA/latency performance, three uplift tiers (10% / 30% / 60%), and expected unit cost delta per tier.
- For the data residency language — we can include an explicit EU logs handling appendix; Naomi, can you draft a short clause and mark which items would require a Private deployment vs hosted?
- Capacity ask: based on your peak TPS and token spikes, our preliminary recommendation is Tier B (30% uplift) to avoid throttling during campaign spikes while keeping near-current unit economics. We can refine after we see the historical export.

Proposed timeline:
1) 2026-06-30 — QBR (confirm time)
2) 2026-07-02 — Procurement receives final SOW for redlines
3) 2026-07-12 — Final sign-off target

I'll create the calendar invite for 2026-06-30 10:30 PT and include a 20m pre-read slot 24 hours before.

Cheers,
